title: Human-DNAseq-chr20-nf-dsl2 pipeline parameters
description: Germline short variant calling (per-sample + joint genotyping) with Samtools and GATK4, plus optional ClinVar/SnpEff annotation

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to a comma-separated samplesheet listing the input BAM files.
input.help_text: CSV with a header row and two columns: `sample_id,reads_bam`. See `assets/schema_input.json` for the exact row schema and `assets/samplesheet.csv` for a template.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be published.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome and accessory files required for variant calling.

reference.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA file.

reference_index.description: Path to the reference genome FASTA index (.fai), e.g. generated with `samtools faidx`.

reference_dict.description: Path to the reference genome sequence dictionary (.dict), e.g. generated with `gatk CreateSequenceDictionary`.

intervals.description: BED file of genomic intervals to restrict variant calling to.

cohort_name.description: Base name used for the final joint-genotyped cohort VCF (<cohort_name>.joint.vcf).

annotation_options.title: Annotation options
annotation_options.description: Optional variant annotation after joint genotyping. Each step runs only when its parameter is set.

contig_offset.description: Add this offset to POS and rename source_contig to target_contig (SHIFT_COORDINATES). Only needed when variants were called against a reference excerpt.
contig_offset.help_text: The bundled test reference is a 29 kb excerpt named `20_10037292_10066351`; its position 1 is GRCh37 chr20:10037293, so the offset is 10037292. Requires `source_contig`, `target_contig` and `target_contig_length`.

source_contig.description: Contig name in the called VCF to shift (e.g. `20_10037292_10066351`).

target_contig.description: Contig name to write instead (must match ClinVar and SnpEff naming, e.g. `20` for GRCh37).

target_contig_length.description: Length written to the new ##contig header line (GRCh37 chr20: 63025520).

ref_check_fasta.description: Full-chromosome FASTA (uncompressed, with a .fai next to it) to check every shifted REF allele against. The run fails on any mismatch.
ref_check_fasta.help_text: Only used together with `contig_offset`. Proves the offset is right before anything is annotated.

clinvar.description: Bgzipped ClinVar VCF (with a .tbi index next to it) for CLINVAR_ANNOTATE. Adds INFO/CLNSIG and INFO/CLNDN.
clinvar.help_text: Use the ClinVar build that matches your reference (GRCh37 for the test data), from https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pub/clinvar/.

snpeff_db.description: SnpEff data directory containing `<snpeff_genome>/snpEffectPredictor.bin`. SnpEff is skipped when unset.
snpeff_db.help_text: Download once with `snpEff download -dataDir /abs/path GRCh37.75`. Not set in the test profile or CI because the database is ~540 MB.

proband.description: Sample name of the child for the de novo filter (FILTER_VARIANTS). Requires `father` and `mother`.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options, typically set via a config file or profile rather than the command line.

help.description: Display the help message and exit.
